  });
});

bookSourceComment:
蕃茄小说手机站（m.dzrjk.com，PC 站 www.dzrjk.com 同库同模板）。 【搜索】/api/search 需 POST 31 个混淆校验变量 + sign，这些变量每次请求由服务端随机生成，必须先从 /user/search.html?q=关键词 页面正则抓取；其中 bgt 必须去掉最后一位字符（站点 common.js 的 search_before() 在 document.cookie 非空时执行 bgt=bgt.slice(0,len-1)，而浏览器必然带 SID cookie），否则服务端返回 {"code":0,"data":{"search":[]}}，把校验失败伪装成“无结果”而不是报错，极易误判为接口失效。 【限频】同一 IP 3 秒内二次搜索返回 code=1「搜索太频繁」。concurrentRate 的单位是毫秒，故写作 1/2000（每 2 秒 1 次），不是 1/2。 【搜索词】站内搜索是分词匹配，超长精确书名（如 11 字全名）会返回空，建议用短关键词，例如搜「无上之境」而不是「斗破苍穹之无上之境」。 【目录】详情页 ul.chapter 一次性输出全部章节（实测 988 章、217 章、280 章、1875 章、5461 章均无分页），无需 nextTocUrl；末章偶发重复前一章链接，Legado 会自动去重。 【正文】#text 内为

段落，无章内分页，不需要 nextContentUrl。个别老章节末尾混有站点残缺文本（形如 id"booktexts">），已用 replaceRegex 清除；注意该规则执行时 HTML 标签已被剥离、且 Java 的 String.replace 不带 MULTILINE，故正则不能写

也不能用 ^...$ 锚点。 【简介】站点自身在 introbar 里截断并加省略号，PC 站同样截断，属站点数据限制。 【发现】分类页与排行榜 URL 中的数字不是页码（实测 1.html、2.html、100.html 内容完全相同，每个分类固定 30 本），故固定用 1.html；上滑翻页会重复返回同一批书，属站点限制。 【bookUrlPattern】用于防止搜索 0 结果时 Legado 走“列表为空按详情页解析”造出假书，同时支持粘贴详情页 URL 直接搜。

<js>
function styles(so) {
    var today = new Date();
    var dateT = today.getFullYear()
        + '-'
        + (today.getMonth() + 1)
        + '-'
        + today.getDate()
        + '_discover_tabs';

    var url = Api('/api/discover/tabs');
    var res = null;
    var cacheData = '';
    var sourceItem = null;
    var result = [];
    var tab;
    var count = 0;
    var i;
    var u;

    try {
        cacheData = cache.get(dateT);

        if (cacheData) {
            try {
                res = JSON.parse(cacheData);
            } catch (e) {
                res = null;
            }
        }

        if (!res) {
            res = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url));

            if (res && res.code == 0) {
                cache.put(dateT, JSON.stringify(res));
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        return [{
            title: '数据加载失败，请刷新后重试',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    if (!res || res.code != 0 || !res.data || !res.data.sources) {
        return [{
            title: '请先登陆，登陆后刷新发现页即可',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    for (i = 0; i < res.data.sources.length; i++) {
        if (res.data.sources[i] && res.data.sources[i].name == so) {
            sourceItem = res.data.sources[i];
            break;
        }
    }

    if (!sourceItem || !sourceItem.tabs || sourceItem.tabs.length == 0) {
        return [{
            title: '暂无' + (so || '') + '发现内容',
            url: '',
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
            }
        }];
    }

    for (i = 0; i < sourceItem.tabs.length; i++) {
        tab = sourceItem.tabs[i];

        if (!tab) {
            continue;
        }

        if (tab.section) {
            if (count > 0) {
                while (count < 3) {
                    result.push({
                        title: '--',
                        url: '',
                        style: {
                            layout_flexGrow: 1,
                            layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
                        }
                    });
                    count++;
                }
            }

            result.push({
                title: tab.title || '',
                url: '',
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 1
                }
            });

            count = 0;
            continue;
        }

        u = '/api/discover/content?source='
            + encodeURIComponent(sourceItem.source || '')
            + '&tab='
            + encodeURIComponent(tab.key || '')
            + '&page={{page}}&page_size=12';

        result.push({
            title: tab.title || '',
            url: Api(u),
            style: {
                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
            }
        });

        count++;

        if (count >= 3) {
            count = 0;
        }
    }

    if (count > 0) {
        while (count < 3) {
            result.push({
                title: '--',
                url: '',
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.25
                }
            });

            count++;
        }
    }

    return result;
}

        1
    )
];

    var match = head.match(/(?:encoding|charset)\s*=\s*["']?\s*([A-Za-z0-9._-]+)/i)
    if (match && match[1]) charset = String(match[1])
    var b0 = Number(bytes[0]) & 255
    var b1 = Number(bytes[1]) & 255
    if (b0 == 255 && b1 == 254) charset = 'UTF-16LE'
    else if (b0 == 254 && b1 == 255) charset = 'UTF-16BE'
  } catch (detectError) {}
  try {
    return String(new Packages.java.lang.String(bytes, charset)).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')
  } catch (charsetError) {
    return String(new Packages.java.lang.String(bytes, 'UTF-8')).replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')
  }
}

function qmDecryptChapter(value) {
  var bytes = qmDecryptChapterBytes(value)
  if (bytes.length > 3 && (Number(bytes[0]) & 255) == 80 && (Number(bytes[1]) & 255) == 75) {
    throw new Error('EPUB 已改为服务器解密，请配置服务地址并刷新书籍目录')
  }
  return qmDecodeTextBytes(bytes)
}

function qmEpubRemoteDecrypt(value) {
  var runtimeJava = qmJavaOf(this)
  if (!runtimeJava || !qmCallable(runtimeJava, 'ajax')) throw new Error('阅读端缺少网络请求能力')
  value = String(value || '')
  if (!value) throw new Error('七猫 EPUB 章节密文为空')
  var headers = {'content-type':'application/json; charset=utf-8','accept':'text/plain'}
  var token = qmLoginValue.call(this, '◎ EPUB服务密钥', '').trim()
  if (!token) throw new Error('请填写EPUB服务密钥')
  headers['X-Qimao-Token'] = token
  var option = {method:'POST',headers:headers,body:JSON.stringify({content:value})}
  var text = String(runtimeJava.ajax(qmEpubServiceBase.call(this) + '/decrypt,' + JSON.stringify(option)) || '').trim()
  if (!text) throw new Error('EPUB 解密服务返回空正文')
  if (/^(decrypt failed|unauthorized|not found|request body)/i.test(text)) throw new Error('EPUB 解密服务：' + text)

}

function qmRememberVideoPage(kind, page, items) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  if (!runtimeCache) return items
  page = String(Number(page || 1) || 1)
  var state = qmVideoState.call(this, kind)
  var prior = {}
  Object.keys(state.pages || {}).forEach(function (key) {
    if (key != page) (state.pages[key] || []).forEach(function (id) { prior[String(id)] = 1 })
  })
  var current = []
  var local = {}
  var filtered = items.filter(function (item) {
    var id = qmItemId(item, 'video')
    if (!id || local[id] || prior[id]) return false
    local[id] = 1
    current.push(String(id))
    return true
  })
  state.pages[page] = current
  Object.keys(state.pages).forEach(function (key) { if (Number(key) < Number(page) - 8) delete state.pages[key] })
  runtimeCache.putMemory('qm-video-pages-' + kind, JSON.stringify(state))
  return filtered
}

function qmCollectExplore(node, mode, output, seen, depth) {

  if (typeof node != 'object') return
  var itemMode = mode == 'publish' ? 'novel' : mode
  var id = qmItemId(node, itemMode)
  if (id && String(id) != '0' && qmIsCandidate(node, itemMode)) {
    var key = mode + '-' + id
    if (!seen[key]) {
      seen[key] = 1
      output.push(qmNormalizeBook.call(ctx, node, itemMode, mode))
    }
  }
  Object.keys(node).forEach(function (key) {
    if (!/^(meta|stat_params|track_id|tag_items|category_list|rank_list)$/.test(key)) {
      qmCollectExplore.call(ctx, node[key], mode, output, seen, depth + 1)

function qmToc(text, baseUrl) {

    try {
      if (runtimeBook) {
        runtimeBook.type = 8
        if (runtimeBook.putVariable) runtimeBook.putVariable('qm_reader_type', readerType)
      }
    } catch (e3) {}
    list = (data.chapter_lists || []).map(function (x) {
      var params = {id:bid,chapterId:String(x.id)}
      if (readerType == '4') params.reader_agent = '1'
      var chapterUrl = qmGetUrl.call(ctx, 'https://api-ks.wtzw.com/api/v1/chapter/content',params)
      var comma = chapterUrl.indexOf(',')
      if (comma >= 0) {
        try {
          var option = JSON.parse(chapterUrl.slice(comma + 1))
          option.qm_reader_type = readerType
          option.qm_content_mode = contentMode

        } catch (optionError) {}
      }
      return {title:x.title,info:'字数 ' + (x.words || '-'),url:chapterUrl}
    })
  }
  return list
}

      var firstUrl = kind == 'paragraph' ? 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/paragraph/first' : 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/chapter-comment/first'

function qmOpenComment(kind, bid, cid, pid, heading, checkId) {
  var html = qmCommentHtml.call(this, kind, bid, cid, pid, heading, checkId)
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(this)
  var runtimeJava = qmJavaOf(this)
  if (!qmCallable(runtimeJava, 'showBrowser')) return false
  runtimeJava.showBrowser('https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/', html, 'window.java=java;window.cache=cache;window.source=source;window.qmRun=run;window.qmLocalCommentPage=true;', JSON.stringify({state:4,isHideable:true,heightPercentage:cfg.height,widthPercentage:1.0,dismissOnTouchOutside:true,skipCollapsed:true,expandedCornersRadius:16,isGestureInsetBottomIgnored:true,hardwareAccelerated:true,webViewInitialScale:100}))
  return true
}

function qmSvg(kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot) {
  var normalizedKind = String(kind || '')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(this)
  var color = cfg.color
  count = Number(count || 0)
  if (count <= 0) return ''
  if (normalizedKind == 'paragraph' && cfg.split) color = hot ? cfg.hotColor : count >= cfg.splitCount ? cfg.splitColor : cfg.color
  count = Math.min(count, 999)
  var svg
  if (normalizedKind == 'paragraph') {
    var displayText = String(Math.min(count, 999))
    var custom = cfg.template == '起点' ? '' : qmLoginValue.call(this, cfg.template.replace('样式', '◎ 气泡'), '')
    svg = custom.trim() ? custom.replace(/\$\{qpyscolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{qpwzcolor\}/g, color).replace(/\$\{font\}/g, 'Arial').replace(/\$\{displayText\}/g, displayText) :
      '<svg viewBox="5 14 45 36" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="180" height="144"><path d="M44 48 Q48 48 48 44 L48 20 Q48 16 44 16 L20 16 Q16 16 16 20 L16 24 S16 28 10 30 Q6 32 10 34 Q16 36 16 38 L16 44 Q16 48 20 48 Z" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="0.7"/><text x="32" y="38" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-weight="600" font-size="18" fill="' + color + '" dominant-baseline="middle">' + displayText + '</text></svg>'
  } else if (normalizedKind == 'book' || normalizedKind == 'chapter') {
    svg = '<svg width="1000" height="128" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="6" y="6" width="988" height="116" rx="12" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="3"/><text x="48" y="79" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="38" fill="' + color + '">' + qmEsc(label) + '</text><text x="950" y="79" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial" font-size="34" fill="' + color + '">' + count + ' 条 ›</text></svg>'
  } else {
    svg = '<svg width="1000" height="800" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><rect x="150" y="150" width="665" height="525" rx="175" fill="none" stroke="' + color + '" stroke-width="18"/><text x="480" y="535" font-family="Arial" text-anchor="middle" font-size="298" fill="' + color + '">' + count + '</text></svg>'
  }
  var encoded = qmBase64Encode(this, svg)
  if (!encoded) return ''
  var call = 'qmOpenComment.call(this,' + [normalizedKind, bid, cid, pid, label || '', checkId || ''].map(function (x) { return JSON.stringify(String(x || '')) }).join(',') + ')'
  var style = normalizedKind == 'paragraph' ? qmCommentConfig.call(this).svgSize : 'FULL'
  return 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + encoded + ',' + JSON.stringify({style:style,type:'qmpl',click:call})
}

function qmBubbleImage(kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot) {
  var data = qmSvg.call(this, kind, bid, cid, pid, count, label, checkId, hot)
  return data ? '<img src="' + data + '">' : ''
}

function qmGodImage(bid, cid, pid, gid, text) {

  if (!gid || !text) return ''
  if (text.length > 18) text = text.slice(0, 18) + '...'
  var svg = '<svg width="1000" height="120" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">' +
    '<rect x="2" y="0" width="996" height="100" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.25)" rx="35" stroke="#888" stroke-width="1"/>' +

  var encoded = qmBase64Encode(this, svg)
  if (!encoded) return ''
  var call = 'qmOpenComment.call(this,' + ['paragraph', bid, cid, pid, '七猫神评', gid].map(function (x) { return JSON.stringify(String(x || '')) }).join(',') + ')'
  var data = 'data:image/svg+xml;base64,' + encoded + ',' + JSON.stringify({style:'FULL',type:'qmpl-god',click:call})
  return '<img src="' + data + '">'
}

function qmChapterReviewCount(bid, cid) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  var key = 'qm-count-chapter-' + bid + '-' + cid
  var saved = runtimeCache && runtimeCache.getFromMemory(key)
  if (saved != null) return Number(saved || 0)
  var data = qmGet.call(this, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/comment/chapter-end-comment', {book_id:bid,chapter_ids:cid}).data || {}
  var comments = data.comments || []
  var count = comments.length ? Number(comments[0].count || 0) : 0
  if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.putMemory(key, String(count))
  return count
}

function qmBookReviewCount(bid) {
  var runtimeCache = qmCacheOf(this)
  var key = 'qm-count-book-' + bid
  var saved = runtimeCache && runtimeCache.getFromMemory(key)
  if (saved != null) return Number(saved || 0)
  var data = qmGet.call(this, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v2/community/book-evaluates', {circle_id:bid,need_common:'0',tag_id:'1',book_id:bid,sort:'0'}).data || {}
  var count = Number(data.evaluates_info && data.evaluates_info.eval_comment_count || data.comment_count || 0)
  if (runtimeCache) runtimeCache.putMemory(key, String(count))
  return count
}

function qmNovelContent(text, baseUrl) {
  var ctx = this
  var raw = qmParse(text).data || {}
  var bid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'id')
  var cid = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'chapterId')
  var cfg = qmCommentConfig.call(ctx)
  var readerType = qmReaderType(ctx, baseUrl)
  var content = readerType == '3' ? qmEpubRemoteDecrypt.call(ctx, raw.content || '') : qmDecryptChapter(raw.content || '')
  if (!qmCommentsAllowed(ctx, baseUrl)) return content
  var marks = {}
  if (cfg.paragraph || cfg.god) {
    try {
      var bubbleResponse = qmPostForm.call(ctx, 'https://api-cmnt.wtzw.com/api/v1/paragraph/bubbles', {
        book_id:bid,chapters:JSON.stringify([{chapter_id:cid,chapter_md5:String(raw.content_md5 || '')}])
      })
      var chapters = bubbleResponse.data && bubbleResponse.data.chapters || []
      var bubbles = chapters.length ? chapters[0].bubbles || [] : []
      bubbles.forEach(function (item) {
        var count = Number(item.c || 0)
        if (count > 0 || item.gid || item.gtxt) marks[String(item.p)] = {count:count,hot:String(item.hot || '') == '1',gid:String(item.gid || ''),gtxt:String(item.gtxt || '')}
      })
    } catch (bubbleError) {}
  }
  var lines = String(content).split('\n')
  lines.forEach(function (line, index) {
    var pid = qmMd5(line).slice(0, 8)
    var mark = marks[pid]
    if (!mark || !line) return
    var bubble = cfg.paragraph ? qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'paragraph', bid, cid, pid, mark.count, mark.hot ? '热门段评' : '七猫段评', mark.gid, mark.hot) : ''
    if (bubble) lines[index] += bubble
    var god = cfg.god ? qmGodImage.call(ctx, bid, cid, pid, mark.gid, mark.gtxt) : ''
    if (god) lines[index] += '\n' + god
  })
  if (cfg.chapter) try { var chapterBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'chapter', bid, cid, '', qmChapterReviewCount.call(ctx, bid, cid), '本章说'); if (chapterBubble) lines.push(chapterBubble) } catch (chapterError) {}
  if (cfg.book) try { var bookBubble = qmBubbleImage.call(ctx, 'book', bid, '', '', qmBookReviewCount.call(ctx, bid), '本书书评'); if (bookBubble) lines.push(bookBubble) } catch (bookError) {}
  return lines.join('\n')
}

function qmContentTitle(value, baseUrl) {
  var text = String(value || '')
  var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
  try { if (runtimeChapter) runtimeChapter.putImgUrl(null) } catch (e) {}
  return text
}

function qmReadContent(text, baseUrl) {
  if (/^data:;base64,/.test(String(baseUrl)) && /["']type["']\s*:\s*["']video["']/.test(String(baseUrl))) {
    return qmHexDecodeAscii(text)
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/playlet/api/info') >= 0) {
    var video = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var playList = video.play_list || []
    var sort = qmUrlValue(baseUrl, 'qm_sort')
    var runtimeChapter = qmChapterOf(this)
    if (!sort) {
      try {
        var titleMatch = String(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.title || '').match(/第\s*(\d+)\s*集/)
        if (titleMatch) sort = titleMatch[1]
      } catch (titleError) {}
    }
    var item = playList.filter(function (x) { return sort && String(x.sort) == String(sort) })[0]
    if (!item) {
      var chapterIndex = -1
      try { chapterIndex = Number(runtimeChapter && runtimeChapter.index) } catch (indexError) {}
      if (chapterIndex >= 0) item = playList[chapterIndex]
    }
    if (!item) item = playList.filter(function (x) { return !!(x.video_url || x.video_url_h265) })[0] || {}
    return String(item.video_url || item.video_url_h265 || '')
  }
  if (String(baseUrl).indexOf('/album/info') >= 0) {
    var audio = qmParse(text).data || {}
    var voices = audio.voice_list || []
    return voices.length ? String(voices[0].voice_url) : '本集暂无可播放音频'
  }
  return qmNovelContent.call(this, text, baseUrl)
}

<js>
function getBookIdFull(url) {
    const {java} = this;
    let $ = JSON.parse(url).data;
    let arr = [];
    if ($.book_shelf_info && $.book_shelf_info.length > 0) {
        arr = $.book_shelf_info.map(item => item.book_id);
    } else if ($.data_list && $.data_list.length > 0) {
        arr = $.data_list.map(item => item.book_id_str);
    } else {
        java.toast("获取 book_id 失败，你可能需要登录！");
    }
    return arr;
}

let session = getSessionId()

getShelf = () => {
    let book_shelf_info = java.ajax(getServerHost() + "/book_shelf?session=" + session)
    
    bid = getBookIdFull(book_shelf_info)
    
    let id_list = splitArray(bid, 200)
    let urls = []
    id_list.forEach(i => {
        urls.push(getServerHost() +"/detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
    })
    res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

    let resp = {book_info: []}
    res.forEach(r => {
        resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
    })

    return resp
}

function getByGroupName(name) {
    let book_shelf_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(getServerHost() +"/book_shelf?session=" + session))
    
    let group_bookids = {
        "未分组": []
    }
    book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info.forEach(i => {
        if (!group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"]) group_bookids[i.group_name] = []
        group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"].push(i.book_id)
    })
    
    if (!group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]) return {data: []}
    
    let book_ids = splitArray(group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)], 200)
    let urls = []

    book_ids.forEach(i => { 	urls.push(getServerHost() +"/detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
    })
    
    res = java.ajaxAll(urls)

    let resp = {book_info: []}
    res.forEach(r => {
        resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
    })

    return resp
}

function getByTabIndex(index) {
    let url = _mlsec.requestHeader(
        "bookmall/tab",
        "version_name=5.8.9.32",
        null,
        "sessionid=" + session
    )
    let all = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url))
    let tab = all.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[index].cell_data
    if (!tab) tab = []
    let bookList = []
    for (let i of tab) {
        bookList = bookList.concat(i.book_data)
    }
    return { book_info: bookList }
}

function getGuessYouLike() {
    let apiUrl = 'https://reading.snssdk.com/reading/bookapi/bookmall/tab/v/?version_name=5.8.9.32&device_id=1024&device_type=114514&iid=2048&aid=1967&channel=0&os_version=0&app_name=novelapp&version_code=58932&device_platform=android'
    let response = java.ajax(apiUrl + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
        headers: {
            'Cookie': "sessionid=" + session
        }
    }))
    let responseData = JSON.parse(response)
    let finalResult = {
        code: 0,
        message: 'SUCCESS',
        data: {
            cell_view: {
                book_data: []
            }
        }
    }
    if (responseData.data && responseData.data.tab_item && responseData.data.tab_item.length > 0 && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data.length > 0 && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[0].cell_data && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[0].cell_data.length > 0 && responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[0].cell_data[0].book_data) {
        finalResult.data.cell_view.book_data = responseData.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[0].cell_data[0].book_data
    }
    return finalResult
}

function normalizeResponse(data) {
    if (data.data && data.data.book_list && Array.isArray(data.data.book_list)) {
        return data.data.book_list;
    }
    
    if (data.book_info) return data.book_info;
    if (data.data && data.data.book_info) return data.data.book_info;
    if (data.data && Array.isArray(data.data)) return data.data;
    if (data.list) return data.list;
    if (data.book_list) return data.book_list;
    if (data.data && data.data.publication_list) return data.data.publication_list;
    if (data.result) return data.result;
    if (data.data && data.data.result) return data.data.result;
    if (data.data && data.data.cell_view && data.data.cell_view.book_data) {
        return data.data.cell_view.book_data;
    }
    if (data.data && data.data.records) return data.data.records;
    if (data.data && data.data.list) return data.data.list;
    
    return [];
}

if (baseUrl.includes("jj_signin")) {
    let decodedToken = java.base64Decode(JJtoken());
    let timestamp = Date.now();
    let enbody = timestamp + ':' + decodedToken;
    let encodedEnbody = encode(enbody);
    
    let signUrl = "https://android.jjwxc.net/androidapi/signin,{\"method\":\"POST\",\"body\":\"versionCode=507&sign=" + encodedEnbody + "\"}";
    
    let signinResult = java.ajax(signUrl);
    
    let result = JSON.parse(signinResult);
    let message = result.message || "签到请求完成";
    
    let responseData = {
        "isSuccess": result.code == "200",
        "errorMsg": result.code == "200" ? "success" : "fail",
        "data": [{
            "title": message
        }]
    };
    
    JSON.stringify(responseData);
} else if (baseUrl.includes("jjbookshelf")) {
    let token = JJtoken();
    let config = getConfig.call(this);
    let latestType = config.type_id || '';
    let jjUrl = baseUrl.replace(/type=[^&]*/, 'type=' + latestType);
    if (!/type=/.test(jjUrl)) {
        jjUrl += (jjUrl.includes('?') ? '&' : '?') + 'type=' + latestType;
    }
    jjUrl = jjUrl + token;
    result = JSON.parse(java.ajax(jjUrl));
    JSON.stringify(result);
} else if (baseUrl.includes("type_style")) {
    let sortKey = getSortKey() || '';
    let newUrl = baseUrl + sortKey;
    result = JSON.parse(java.ajax(newUrl));
    
    let normalizedData = normalizeResponse(result);
    JSON.stringify({data: normalizedData});
} else if (baseUrl.endsWith("bookshelf")) {
    result = getShelf("bookshelf/info")
} else if(/read_history/.test(baseUrl)) {
    let pageMatch = baseUrl.match(/page=(\d+)/);
    let page = pageMatch ? pageMatch[1] : '1';
    
    let history_response = java.ajax(getServerHost() + "/read_history?session=" + session + "&page=" + page)
    let history_data = JSON.parse(history_response)
    
    if (history_data.data.data_list) {
        let book_ids = history_data.data.data_list.map(item => item.book_id_str)
        
        let id_list = splitArray(book_ids, 200)
        let urls = []
        id_list.forEach(i => {
          urls.push(getServerHost() +"/detail?book_id=" + i.join(","))
        })
        
        let resp = {book_info: []}
        urls.forEach(url => {
            let detailResponse = java.ajax(url)
            let detailData = JSON.parse(detailResponse)
            if (detailData.data) {
                resp.book_info = resp.book_info.concat(detailData.data)
            }
        })
        
        result = resp
    } else {
        result = {book_info: []}
    }
} else if (baseUrl.includes("style_top")) {
    result = JSON.parse(result);
} else if (baseUrl.includes("/tab/cai")) {
    result = getGuessYouLike();
} else {
    let w = baseUrl.split("/")
    if (baseUrl.includes("groupName")) {
        result = getByGroupName(w[w.length - 1])
    } else if (baseUrl.includes("tab")) {
        result = getByTabIndex(parseInt(w[w.length - 1]))
    } else {
        result = JSON.parse(result)
        if (result.data && result.data.data) {
            result = {book_info: result.data.data}
        }
    }
}

if (!baseUrl.includes("jjbookshelf") && !baseUrl.includes("type_style") && !baseUrl.includes("jj_signin")) {
    let normalizedData = normalizeResponse(result);
    JSON.stringify({data: normalizedData})
}
</js>

版本: 20261026
作者: 知秋
反馈群：766236637
tg群：https://t.me/+dcNnFFZv5KtmYjIx
1. 使用服务器进行中转，有请求速率限制，小说为一分钟300次，支持小说下载请不要太夸张。
2. 临时token口令为 天一团队是倒狗(qq为1070240776和845646066和1484608559)请勿相信任何需要付费的说法欢迎来官方反馈群举报
3. 获取token请点击登录界面，获取token按钮，点击测试/修改token可查询日下载量，切记获取token后请保存，最后选择√存储成功，token为3日有效期，到期请重新获取，切记token变为明文，请勿外泄，异地登录多次会封禁token，如封禁请等过期重新获取。(token改为明文存源变量中防止丢失)
4. 共享数据库如有，则优先使用数据库，共享章节开头的图标为🍅
5. 支持下载，请把预下载改成0-10之间，请求有超限拉黑，请勿大规模批量下载
6. 搜索类型会随着书源模式改变，听书模式，默认搜索听书
7.   搜索小说：以字母n开头；
      搜索漫画：以字母c开头；
      搜索听书：以字母a开头；
      搜索短剧：以字母v开头；
8. 听小说模式适配ai音色听书，选择此模式刷新发现即可，详情页有书籍支持音色，自定义音色听书或者采取下列方式也可(注意听书模式为真人主播，自定义音色无法生效)
    ai配音听书需要a➕bookid搜索即可，默认皆为真人(小说的支持ai音色请看小说详情页简介处的音色即可获得，每个数字代表一个音色)
9. 反馈q群：755947375，token问题群里找我，或者社区找也行(社区不经常在线，上线看到会回)
10. 段评，章评，书评。在登录界面开启关闭
11. 颜色可以在登录界面自行更改
12. 接口请求速率存在限制，请不要大规模下载，耐心等待。

<js>
let ck = "sessionid=" + (String(cookie.getKey("fanqienovel.com", "sessionid")) ? String(cookie.getKey("fanqienovel.com", "sessionid")) : (source.getLoginInfoMap() || {})['手动登录Token'])

function getBooksInfo(novelIds) {
  let urls = []
  novelIds.forEach(i => {
    urls.push(getApiUrl('/novel/info', { novelId: i }))
  })
  let res = java.ajaxAll(urls)
  let resp = { book_info: [] }
  res.forEach(r => {
    resp.book_info.push(JSON.parse(r.body()).data)
  })
  return resp
}

let getShelf = () => {
  let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=57700&update_version_code=57700'
  let book_shelf_info = java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
    headers: {
      'Cookie': ck
    }
  }))
  let bids = getBookIdFull(book_shelf_info)
  return getBooksInfo(bids)
}

function getByGroupName(name) {
  let book_shelf_url = 'https://fanqienovel.com/reading/bookapi/bookshelf/info/v:version/?aid=1967&iid=0&version_code=57700&update_version_code=57700'

  let book_shelf_info = JSON.parse(java.ajax(book_shelf_url + ', ' + JSON.stringify({
    headers: {
      'Cookie': ck,
    }
  })))
  let group_bookids = {
    "未分组": []
  }
  book_shelf_info.data.book_shelf_info.forEach(i => {
    if (!group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"]) group_bookids[i.group_name] = []
    group_bookids[i.group_name ? i.group_name : "未分组"].push(i.book_id)
  })
  if (!group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]) return { data: [] }
  let book_ids = group_bookids[decodeURIComponent(name)]
  return getBooksInfo(book_ids)
}

function getByTabIndex(index) {
  let url = xGorgon(
    "bookmall/tab",
    "version_name=5.8.9.32&device_id=1024&device_type=114514&iid=2048",
    null,
    ck
  )
  let all = JSON.parse(java.ajax(url))
  let tab = all.data.tab_item[0].cell_data[index]
  tab = tab.cell_data
  if (!tab) tab = []
  let bookList = []
  for (let i of tab) {
    if (!i.book_data) {
      let nexttab = i.cell_data || []
      nexttab
        .filter(i => i.show_type === 125)
        .forEach(i => bookList = bookList.concat(i.book_data || []))
    } else {
      bookList = bookList.concat(i.book_data)
    }
  }
  return { book_info: bookList }
}

if (baseUrl.endsWith("bookshelf")) result = getShelf("bookshelf/info")
else {
  let w = baseUrl.split("/")
  if (baseUrl.includes("groupName")) {
    result = getByGroupName(w[w.length - 1])
  } else if (baseUrl.includes("tab")) {
    result = getByTabIndex(parseInt(w[w.length - 1]))
  } else if (baseUrl.includes("reading.snssdk.com")) {
    bids = baseUrl.match(/book_id=([\d,]+)/)[1].split(",")
    result = getBooksInfo(bids)
  } else {
    java.log(result)
    result = JSON.parse(result)
  }
}

java.log('result:' + JSON.stringify(result))
JSON.stringify({ data: result.book_info || result.data.book_info || result.detail_list || result.data.novels || (result.data.cell_view && result.data.cell_view.book_data) || result.data })
</js>

var chapters = data.item_data_list || data.catalog_data || data.item_list || [];
if (!Array.isArray(chapters)) chapters = [];

// v0.76 目录阶段「零跨桥」：宿主对 ruleToc 的 chapterName/chapterUrl/updateTime 是**按章**
// 求值的，807 章 = 807 × 3 次。旧写法把「拼章节链接」放在 chapterUrl 的 @js 里，每章要读

// GET('server_check_time') + GET('api_key')）；宿主里每次读都是跨引擎调用（真机 2.6-5ms），
// 807 章就是 4000+ 次 ⇒ 目录阶段实测被拖到 10s 量级，弱宿主 15s 脚本预算被打爆、
// getChapterList 直接超时。这里把每章需要的链接与更新时间**一次算完写进章节对象**，

// 探出模板再按章替换，避免自己重写 query 拼接顺序而与正文阶段对不上。
var pyfqLinkHead = '';
var pyfqLinkTail = '';
try {
  var pyfqBookId = String(queryValue(baseUrl, 'book_id') || GET.call(this, 'bookId') || '');
  var pyfqTemplate = String(API.call(this, '/api/ping?q=__PYFQ_ITEM__&book_id=' + encodeURIComponent(pyfqBookId) + '&ys_module=' + encodeURIComponent(module)) || '');
  var pyfqParts = pyfqTemplate.split('q=__PYFQ_ITEM__');

// 用 java.timeFormatUTC 的话每章都要跨一次桥，又是 807 次。入参是秒，
// 与旧规则 java.getString(...) * 1000 的语义保持一致。
function pyfqFormatUTC8(sec) {
  var n = Number(sec || 0);
  if (!n || isNaN(n)) return '';
  var d = new Date(n * 1000 + 8 * 3600 * 1000);
  if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return '';

  return d.getUTCFullYear() + '-' + p2(d.getUTCMonth() + 1) + '-' + p2(d.getUTCDate()) +
    ' ' + p2(d.getUTCHours()) + ':' + p2(d.getUTCMinutes()) + ':' + p2(d.getUTCSeconds());
}

if (switchEnabled.call(this, 'richToc') && chapters.length) {
  try {
    var bookId = queryValue(baseUrl, 'book_id') || GET.call(this, 'bookId');
    var infoById = {};
    var richRoot = requestJSON.call(this, '/api/catalog_rich?book_id=' + encodeURIComponent(bookId));
    var richData = richRoot.data || {};
    var richItems = Array.isArray(richData.items) ? richData.items : (Array.isArray(richData) ? richData : []);
    richItems.forEach(function(item) {
      var id = String(item.item_id || item.group_id || '');
      if (id) infoById[id] = item;
    });
    chapters.forEach(function(chapter) {
      var id = String(chapter.itemId || chapter.item_id || '');
      var info = infoById[id] || {};
      var meta = [];
      var words = Number(info.chapter_word_number || 0);
      if (words > 0) meta.push(words + '字');
      if (Number(info.status || 0) != 0) meta.push('锁定');
      var toneCount = Number(info.tone_count || 0);
      if (!toneCount) {
        var tones = info.tts_info && info.tts_info.tone;
        toneCount = Array.isArray(tones) ? tones.length : 0;
      }
      if (toneCount > 0) meta.push(toneCount + '音色');
      var title = String(chapter.title || info.title || '');
      var summary = String(info.chapter_abstract || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      // 视频/漫画类章节的 chapter_abstract 返回的是 HTML 转义后的媒体元数据
      // （{"duration":...} / {"materials":{"img_0":...}}），不是正文摘要。
      // 直接拼进 richTitle 会让阅读端章节名出现 JSON 残片，这里按结构特征剔除。
      if (summary && (summary.charAt(0) == '{' || summary.charAt(0) == '[' || summary.indexOf('"') >= 0 || summary.indexOf('"duration"') >= 0 || summary.indexOf('"materials"') >= 0)) summary = '';
      if (summary.length > 36) summary = summary.slice(0, 36) + '...';
      chapter.richTitle = title + (meta.length ? '  [' + meta.join(' · ') + ']' : '') + (summary ? '\n' + summary : '');
    });
  } catch (error) {
    java.log('富目录已回退普通目录：' + error);
  }
}

// 逐章预焙 + 精简投影：宿主只在逐章规则里用到 title/richTitle/pyfqUrl/pyfqUpdate 四个字段，
// 原始章节对象的 content_md5/version/chapter_type 等对阅读端毫无用处，却要按字节走一遍弱网
// 下载（807 章 × 每字段都是实打实的时长），因此这里只 JSON.stringify 精简后的对象。
chapters.map(function(chapter) {
  var id = String(chapter.itemId || chapter.item_id || '');
  var item = {
    title: String(chapter.title || ''),
    pyfqUrl: pyfqLinkHead ? (pyfqLinkHead + encodeURIComponent(id) + pyfqLinkTail) : '',
    pyfqUpdate: ''
  };
  var updateText = pyfqFormatUTC8(chapter.first_pass_time || chapter.firstPassTime);
  var volume = String(chapter.volume_name || '').replace(/第一卷：默认/g, '').trim();
  item.pyfqUpdate = volume ? (updateText ? volume + '  | ' + updateText : volume) : updateText;
  if (chapter.richTitle) item.richTitle = String(chapter.richTitle);
  return JSON.stringify(item);
});

<js>
list = [];
data = JSON.parse(src).data;
chargeContUrlPrefix = data.chargeContUrlPrefix;
freeContUrlPrefix = data.freeContUrlPrefix;
shortContUrlPrefix = data.shortContUrlPrefix;
chapterList = data.chapterList;
var sqMetaMap = {};
var sqShortMap = {};
var sqCatalogBookId = "";
try { sqCatalogBookId = String(bookId || ""); } catch(e) {}
if (!sqCatalogBookId) {
  var sqBookMatch = String(baseUrl || "").match(/bookId=(\d+)/);
  if (sqBookMatch) sqCatalogBookId = sqBookMatch[1];
}
function sqFmtCatalogTime(ts) {
  var d = new Date(Number(ts || 0) * 1000);
  if (!Number(ts || 0)) return "";
  function pad(n) { return n < 10 ? "0" + n : String(n); }
  return d.getFullYear() + "-" + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + pad(d.getDate()) + " " + pad(d.getHours()) + ":" + pad(d.getMinutes());
}
for (i in chapterList) {
  volumeName = chapterList[i].volumeName;
  list.push({ chapterName: "🏮〖" + volumeName + "〗🏮", isVolume: true });
  chapterList[i].volumeList.forEach($ => {
    var suffix = String($.contUrlSuffix || "");
    var realChapterUrl = ($.isFreeRead ? freeContUrlPrefix : chargeContUrlPrefix) + suffix;
    realChapterUrl = String(realChapterUrl || "").replace(/0$/, "1");
    var currentBookId = String(sqCatalogBookId || "");
    var currentChapterId = String($.chapterId || "");
    chapterUrl = realChapterUrl + "#sqBid=" + encodeURIComponent(currentBookId) + "&sqCid=" + encodeURIComponent(currentChapterId);
    shortUrl = shortContUrlPrefix + String($.shortContUrlSuffix || "");
    time = sqFmtCatalogTime($.chapterUpdateTime);
    wordCount = $.wordCount + "字";
    chapterPrice = $.chapterPrice != "0" && !$.isFreeRead ? $.chapterPrice + "书豆" : "";
    if (suffix) {
      sqMetaMap[suffix] = { bookId: currentBookId, chapterId: currentChapterId };
      if (shortUrl) sqShortMap[suffix] = shortUrl;
    }
    list.push({
      chapterName: $.chapterName,
      chapterUrl: chapterUrl,
      isVip: !$.isFreeRead,
      isPay: $.isBuy,
      chapterInfo: [volumeName, time, wordCount, chapterPrice].join("丨").replace(/丨$/, "")
    });
  });
}
try {
  java.put("sqMetaMap", JSON.stringify(sqMetaMap));
  java.put("sqShortMap", JSON.stringify(sqShortMap));
  _sqMetaMapCache = null;
  _sqShortMapCache = null;
} catch(eMap) {}
list
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
list = [];
data = JSON.parse(src).data;
chargeContUrlPrefix = data.chargeContUrlPrefix;
freeContUrlPrefix = data.freeContUrlPrefix;
shortContUrlPrefix = data.shortContUrlPrefix;
chapterList = data.chapterList;
var sqMetaMap = {};
var sqShortMap = {};
var sqCatalogBookId = "";
try { sqCatalogBookId = String(bookId || ""); } catch(e) {}
if (!sqCatalogBookId) {
  var sqBookMatch = String(baseUrl || "").match(/bookId=(\d+)/);
  if (sqBookMatch) sqCatalogBookId = sqBookMatch[1];
}
function sqFmtCatalogTime(ts) {
  var d = new Date(Number(ts || 0) * 1000);
  if (!Number(ts || 0)) return "";
  function pad(n) { return n < 10 ? "0" + n : String(n); }
  return d.getFullYear() + "-" + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + "-" + pad(d.getDate()) + " " + pad(d.getHours()) + ":" + pad(d.getMinutes());
}
for (i in chapterList) {
  volumeName = chapterList[i].volumeName;
  list.push({ chapterName: "🏮〖" + volumeName + "〗🏮", isVolume: true });
  chapterList[i].volumeList.forEach($ => {
    var suffix = String($.contUrlSuffix || "");
    var realChapterUrl = ($.isFreeRead ? freeContUrlPrefix : chargeContUrlPrefix) + suffix;
    realChapterUrl = String(realChapterUrl || "").replace(/0$/, "1");
    var currentBookId = String(sqCatalogBookId || "");
    var currentChapterId = String($.chapterId || "");
    chapterUrl = realChapterUrl;
    shortUrl = shortContUrlPrefix + String($.shortContUrlSuffix || "");
    time = sqFmtCatalogTime($.chapterUpdateTime);
    wordCount = $.wordCount + "字";
    chapterPrice = $.chapterPrice != "0" && !$.isFreeRead ? $.chapterPrice + "书豆" : "";
    if (suffix) {
      sqMetaMap[suffix] = { bookId: currentBookId, chapterId: currentChapterId };
      if (shortUrl) sqShortMap[suffix] = shortUrl;
    }
    list.push({
      chapterName: $.chapterName,
      chapterUrl: chapterUrl,
      isVip: !$.isFreeRead,
      isPay: $.isBuy,
      chapterInfo: [volumeName, time, wordCount, chapterPrice].join("丨").replace(/丨$/, "")
    });
  });
}
try {
  java.put("sqMetaMap", JSON.stringify(sqMetaMap));
  java.put("sqShortMap", JSON.stringify(sqShortMap));
  _sqMetaMapCache = null;
  _sqShortMapCache = null;
} catch(eMap) {}
list
</js>

var bookId = '';
var r = String(result || '');
if (/^\d{5,10}$/.test(r)) {
    bookId = r;
}
if (!bookId) {
    try {
        var b64 = String(java.base64DecodeToString(r));
        if (/^\d{5,10}$/.test(b64)) bookId = b64;
    } catch(e) {}
}
if (!bookId) {
    try {
        var hx = String(java.hexDecodeToString(r));
        if (/^\d{5,10}$/.test(hx)) bookId = hx;
    } catch(e) {}
}
if (!bookId) {
    var m = r.match(/(\d{5,10})/);
    if (m) bookId = m[1];
}
if (!bookId) throw new Error('无法获取bookId');
var res = java.ajax(getUrl('/book/info/book?bookId=' + bookId));
res = JSON.parse(res);
if (res.code != 100 && res.data && res.data.bookInfo) {
    res.data.bookInfo.intro = res.message;
}
JSON.stringify(res.data);
</js>

【话本小说 · 使用说明】(本书源基于 Legado MD3 版本制作调试)

■ 这是什么
话本小说网(www.ihuaben.com)书源, 以同人/原创小说为主, 免费在线阅读。

■ 搜索说明
1. 支持书名/作者搜索(话本站内搜索 so.ihuaben.com)
2. 注意: 话本是同人/原创平台, 没有主流网文(如斗破苍穹等搜不到属正常)
3. 若开「精确搜索」, 只返回书名与关键词完全一致的结果

■ 发现页(5个榜单)
点击榜 / 评论榜 / 收藏榜 / 新书榜 / 新手村, 各100条

■ 正文阅读
1. 章节开头的角色对话已排版为「头像+名字：台词」(模拟聊天, 线性排列)
2. 已自动清除: 评论数字徽标、段评、作者语(角色对话保留)
3. 正文插图已保留; 文字嵌入模式下头像按文字行高显示(较小)

■ MD3版本注意事项
1. 若换书后图片样式未生效: 从书架删除该书重新加入
2. 首次打开较长的书, 目录页(全量章节)加载略慢属正常
3. 图片排版受Legado MD3文本阅读器限制: 图片只能「小尺寸内联同行」或「大尺寸独占一行」, 无法像原网站聊天气泡那样左右分栏

    var nm = t.select('.name').first();
    var name = nm ? nm.text() : '';
    var msg = t.select('.talkcontent p').text();
    var p = doc.createElement('p');
    if (avatarSrc) {
      var img = doc.createElement('img');
      img.attr('src', avatarSrc);
      p.appendChild(img);
    }
    p.appendText(name + '：' + msg);
    t.replaceWith(p);
  }
  result = cs.html();
}
result;
</js>

        var h = 5381;
        for (var i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
            h = ((h << 5) + h + str.charCodeAt(i)) & 0xffffffff;
        }

        function decryptEfi(efi, tingId, creationTime) {
            var tingClean = tingId.replace(/-/g, '');
            var timeStr = creationTime.replace(/-/g, '').replace(/:/g, '').replace(/T/g, '').replace(/\./g, '').replace(/ /g, '');
            var timePadded = timeStr.padEnd(20, '0');

            function gk(t, tm) {
                var r = '';
                for (var i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
                    r += String.fromCharCode(t.charCodeAt(i) + Number(tm[i]));
                }
                for (var i = 20; i < t.length; i++) {
                    r += String.fromCharCode(t.charCodeAt(i) + Number(tm[i - 20]));
                }
                return r;
            }
            function gi(t, tm) {
                var r = '';
                for (var i = 20; i > 4; i--) {
                    r += String.fromCharCode(t.charCodeAt(i) + Number(tm[i - 1]));
                }
                return r;
            }

            var keyStr = gk(tingClean, timePadded);
            var ivStr = gi(tingClean, timePadded);
            var keyB64 = java.base64Encode(keyStr);
            var ivB64 = java.base64Encode(ivStr);

            var keyBytes = java.base64DecodeToByteArray(keyB64);
            var ivBytes = java.base64DecodeToByteArray(ivB64);
            var ciphertext = java.base64DecodeToByteArray(efi);
            var secretKey = javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec(keyBytes, "AES");
            var ivSpec = javax.crypto.spec.IvParameterSpec(ivBytes);
            var cipher = javax.crypto.Cipher.getInstance("AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
            cipher.init(javax.crypto.Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey, ivSpec);
            var plainBytes = cipher.doFinal(ciphertext);
            var plainText = new Packages.java.lang.String(plainBytes, "UTF-8");
            return plainText;
        }

        var decrypted = decryptEfi(efi, tingId, creationTime);
        var audioPath = '';
        try {
            var resultObj = JSON.parse(decrypted);
            audioPath = resultObj.url || resultObj.audioUrl || resultObj.playUrl || '';
        } catch(e) {
            audioPath = decrypted;

            }
        } else {

    }
}

else {
